title: Model Context Protocol Specification (2025-06-18)
notes: Authoritative protocol reference; primary source for wire format, methods, capabilities, server-side conventions.

notes: Stdlib HTTP server used for streamable-HTTP transport; http.Server.Shutdown for graceful drain.

title: core/event redaction pipeline

title: core/llm registry
notes: In-tree LLM registry; consumed by sampling callbacks under the bundle's resolved provider profile.

title: core/secrets registry
notes: In-tree secrets backend; resolves bearer-token credential references for HTTP authentication.

title: core/bundle resolver
notes: Stub interface today; the bundle-format-resolver mission lands the full Resolver. The mcp-server mission consumes the Resolver via dependency injection at Start.

title: kaneaz-harness Project Charter
notes: Governance and policy doctrine; informs DIRECTIVE_001 layering, local-first deployment constraints, SOC 2-ready audit requirements.

notes: Reused JSON-RPC framing layer from the companion MCP-client mission. Server imports the same package OR triggers a refactor to core/mcp/jsonrpc/ for symmetry.

title: core/session executor
notes: In-tree session executor; consumed by the run_bundle tool implementation.

title: core/scheduler
notes: In-tree scheduler façade; potential future tool exposure (not in v1 catalog).
